# Map Style

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A basemap style with your changes: layers hidden or recolored, from the style editor. Wire it into the deck's map style.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "map-style", "name": "map-style", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "mapStyle"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
